View.text: Storage macOS uses to download and install updates, and the restore points Time Machine keeps on this disk.
Update payloads in the system asset store. A paused or failed download can stay here until macOS retries or removes it.
The Update volume holds an update while macOS prepares and installs it. It is normally small between updates.
Boot files, security cryptexes and any staged update. Never delete anything here; finishing the update shrinks it.

Snapshots keep the blocks of files you deleted since they were taken, so deleting a file may not free space at once. macOS removes them automatically when space runs low; no file scan can measure how much each one holds.
Drag items here to mark them for cleanup
